8.3.18 CanIf_CheckWakeup
[SWS_CANIF_00219] Definition of API function CanIf_CheckWakeup ⌈
Service Name
CanIf_CheckWakeup
Syntax
Std_ReturnType CanIf_CheckWakeup (
EcuM_WakeupSourceType WakeupSource
)
Service ID [hex]
0x11
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
WakeupSource
Source device, which initiated the wake up event: CAN controller
or CAN transceiver
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Will be returned, if the check wake up request has been
accepted
E_NOT_OK: Will be returned, if the check wake up request has
not been accepted
Description
This service checks, whether an underlying CAN driver or a CAN transceiver driver already
signals a wakeup event.
Available via
CanIf.h
⌋
Note: Integration Code calls this function
[SWS_CANIF_00398]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If parameter WakeupSource of CanIf_CheckWakeup() has an invalid value,
CanIf shall report development error code CANIF_E_PARAM_WAKEUPSOURCE to the
Det_ReportError service of the DET, when CanIf_CheckWakeup() is called.⌋
Note: The call context of CanIf_CheckWakeup() is either on interrupt level (interrupt
mode) or on task level (polling mode).
